- DPO/Privacy: strong preference for VPC deployment; open to Dedicated if contractual + technical controls are solid.
- Platform Eng: wants managed experience; “we don’t want to become an inference company.”

What they want to build (use cases)

- Call/chat summarization and quality review for contact center.
